antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 635nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in osteoblast if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2025) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Transcranial 870nm: neuron-specific at 345 THz, low irradiance 22.2 mW/cm^2, 40min targeting NO_synthase in osteoblast. Study reference: 2025 peer-reviewed paper shows NO modulation at 635nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial complex_IV_cytochrome_c_oxidase activation.
